parameters.query:
SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.created_at DESC), '[]'::json) AS leads FROM (
  SELECT s.lead_id, s.source, s.created_at, s.duplicate_status, s.processing_status, s.processing_attempts,
         s.last_error_code, s.review_required, s.uncertainty_flags, s.company_id, s.contact_id,
         s.normalized_payload AS daten, co.company_name, co.website, ct.contact_name, ct.email, ct.phone,
         trade_fair.get_lead_status(s.lead_id, s.submission_id) AS status
  FROM trade_fair.lead_submissions s
  JOIN trade_fair.companies co ON co.company_id = s.company_id
  LEFT JOIN trade_fair.contacts ct ON ct.contact_id = s.contact_id
  ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 2000
) x;
